list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, as published by PlayStation (kit starter list; Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55 names, descriptions and grades). Hidden flags corrected 20 Nov 2026: 28 hidden = 27 bronze + 1 gold, verified name-by-name across GTABase, OutputLag and eGamers. Platinum and Strangers & Freaks are VISIBLE; Let's Go Bowling and Actions Speak Louder are HIDDEN.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of everything else: earn the other 54 trophies and it unlocks on its own. Work the seven roadmap stages in order and let the checklist do the counting.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
Follow the seven roadmap stages in order — story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles, robberies, and the 100% cleanup.
Budget around 200 hours for the full run; some guides estimate 250-300 hours. The exact story-mission total is disputed (91 vs 94 vs 118), so do not plan around a single number.

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play Gone Fishing to the end and the first story trophy pops — the start of a run that ends, about 200 hours later, at the platinum.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end; the trophy pops when it completes.
It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — it unlocks through normal story progress.
It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, like the other early story trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops just after the chapter turns, and it is also where the one disputed early step in the whole list lives: meditate on the Chapter 1 balcony before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — 15 manual slots plus one autosave are available, so rotate 10 saves across the chapters and keep 5 spare for free-roam cleanup.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, right after the mission Welcome to Vice City — pure story progress, nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: The trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission 'Welcome to Vice City'.
Unmissable story progress; no side content is needed for it.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Two missions into the next chapter — Ocean Beach, then Another Life — the trophy pops. Chapter 3 is also where most side chains open, so it is the moment to start the roadmap's second stage.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Complete the first two missions of the next chapter, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
Unmissable; it follows automatically from story play.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, as the official description states. One warning: guides disagree on whether the final mission sits in Chapter 4 or Chapter 5, so this guide never uses a chapter number for the finale itself.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4; the description itself names the chapter.
Chapter numbering for the finale is disputed: PowerPyx places the final mission 'Starting From Zero' in Chapter 4, while GTABase places 'Operation Savage Glory' in Chapter 5.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: The gold story reward: finish the final mission. Follow the mission itself, not a chapter number — the sources disagree on whether the finale is Chapter 4 or Chapter 5, and either number can mislead.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish the final story mission; the trophy is the gold story reward.
Do not rely on a chapter number for the finale — sources disagree (Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5); follow the mission itself.
Hidden until earned; it is the only hidden gold trophy in the list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A straight story trophy — play the mission through and it pops.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Complete the mission Breakfast Run.
Unmissable story trophy.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Straight story progress — no preparation, no missable step.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story progress only.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Complete the mission Child's Play.
Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story progress only.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Complete the mission Headliners.
Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story progress only — the airport itself matters again later, for the unscheduled departure in Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.
Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Note the chapter dispute: GTABase places this mission in Chapter 5, while PowerPyx places the final mission in Chapter 4 — so this guide never states an absolute chapter for the endgame.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Chapter numbering for the endgame is disputed: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5; PowerPyx places the final mission in Chapter 4.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: The long gold: attain 100% completion. The checklist has 35 lines in three groups, opens only after the story, and eleven lines allow no slack at all. Everything in stages 1-5 feeds it; this stage is the cleanup.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Open the 100% checklist in Progress > Stats after the story; it stays locked until the story is complete, but everything done before then still counts.
The checklist has 35 lines in three groups: Story and Tasks 45% (12 lines), Exploration and Activities 45% (20 lines), Discovery 10% (3 lines).

Eleven lines allow no slack: story completion, gang operations 39/39, bank jobs 22/22, payday loan jobs 7/7, bank vaults 8/8, underwater discoveries 33/33, unique playlists 2/2, shooting-range golds 42/42, video games 4/4, drone time trials 42/42, and Bret's target decks 15/15. One missing line keeps the checklist short of 100.
Most other lines need less than the full count: flamingos 100/125, stunts 300/397, vehicles 200/277, meditation 15/18, challenges 70/80, card sets 15/18.

Bank jobs total 22 (14 small + 8 vault), payday loans 7/7, smash 'n' grabs 34/35, stick ups 50/91; fencing lines are $250,000 marked bills, $200,000 vehicles, $100,000 jewelry and $100,000 narcotics; optional tasks need 100. The reward is this gold trophy — neither guide reports any other in-game reward for 100%.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. The 100% checklist needs 300 of 397, so keep going to 300 and both finish together. Under-bridge flights are the fastest way to pile them up.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Pull off 250 stunts; the 100% checklist needs 300 of 397, so going to 300 covers both.
The 397 break down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; under-bridge runs are the fastest.
Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts; R3 shows progress per region.
Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists found and finished stunts by their unique names.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — no gold standard, no winning streak, just one try of each. Check the list, then tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (sink one ball), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt.
Track them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
No gold standard is needed — one try of each type is enough.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges — 18 at Griffin, 24 at Rodgers Ranch. Ignore the 12-vs-14 range count dispute: the agreed facts are 42 golds and two ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across two ranges: the Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero) and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn).
Community checklists split the 42 as 18 golds at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch.
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers for gold; some stay locked until their requirement is met and show on the map.
Track them in Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Range time also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. The races also bank drone time trials — 3 per location — and the 100% checklist needs all 42, so the two goals finish together.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations.
Some locations charge an entry fee.
Track them in Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
100% needs all 42 drone time trials (3 per location), so winning the races also banks the trials.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Forty are available and the same race never counts twice, so keep moving to new events — and keep going past 20, because 100% needs 30 unique race wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Win 20 different races; 40 races are available and the same race never counts twice.
Most race locations let you rent a car; car rating matters and can be raised at Mod Shops.
Track them in Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
100% needs 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Meet him in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, wait for his text, then catch the parrotfish he asks for — over 2 kg.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Cal asks for a parrotfish over 2 kg; bring a boat and a rod — many boats can be taken in the area.
Exophase lists this as the most-earned trophy outside the story, at 1.89%.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — clear every level once. Four video games exist, and the 100% checklist needs all four played, but this trophy needs just one finished.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Finish one of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (TV at home, from Chapter 1) or Bang For Your Buck (arcade machine).
Finishing means clearing every level once; side challenges are not required.
100% needs all four played, but the trophy needs just one finished.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. The chain is Lucia-only, starts in Chapter 3 with a call and a text giving an address in Belville, and runs five quests through the Cellerica storyline.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Finish Andy's final mission; the chain is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 with a call and a text giving an address in Belville.
The five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse).
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Recover 7 shipwreck treasures with a metal detector — and do not panic when Kenton vanishes after Chapter 1; he comes back in Chapters 2-3.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Finish Kenton's final mission; the chain starts in Chapter 1 after 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento.
Recover 7 shipwreck treasures with a metal detector; track them in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton vanishes for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3; as Jason in Chapter 2, calling Brian speeds his return.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. Five quests, starting after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, ending with Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Finish Billy's final mission; the chain starts after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes.
Hometown Heroes is also Billy's final mission.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only four strands are confirmed as counting, the game never says which ones counted, and Yago's race is the one possibly missable step in the whole list — do it the moment the hourglass appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (3 quests), Kyle (3), Yago (4) and Pilot Pete (5).
These do not count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie; PowerPyx notes strangers remain undiscovered.

Watch: Yago's 'Race Against Yago' is time-sensitive — do it as soon as the hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3, and save first. The game never says which strands counted, so check the trophy counter after each strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission by stealing the 16 wishlist cars. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, and good condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Finish Randy's final mission; the chain needs a Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'.
Steal the 16 wishlist cars (Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D).
Track them in Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; the green 'RK' icon sits west of Vice City, and the cars often appear around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Good condition pays more.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Jason-only, starting after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the Synthetic Labs, then shut them down for good.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Finish Tyrone's final mission; the chain is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'.
A purple Synthetic Labs marker appears in Vice City; destroy the lab in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then run 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs).
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 named spots. Eight spots count twice (once per character); the Chapter 1 balcony and Ascent count once. Do the balcony in Chapter 1: whether it counts is disputed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 named spots; a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played.
Meditations 1-3: Jason's House (1), then Smooth Sand (2-3, Mariana County, sandbar west of Capri).
Meditations 4-7: Swamp (4-5, Buckskin Swamp, wooden dock near the tower) and Worn Stone (6-7, Emerald River bank, Camp Moonflower).
Meditations 8-11: Red Rocks (8-9, Manifest Canyon, rail line crossing the highway) and Water Wheel (10-11, Lummox County, ruined paper-mill water wheel south of Moreau).
Meditations 12-15: Jutting Cliff (12-13, tower facing the quarry, Mount Kalaga National Park) and Waterfall (14-15, north-west Tallaloko, river waterfall to the east).
Meditations 16-17: Seaside (Leonard County, rock outcrop east of Waning Sands).
Meditation 18: Ascent Mountain, the stone circle on the Mount Kalaga summit — it only appears after all other spots are done, with a popup notification.
The arithmetic: eight of the ten spots count twice (once per character), while the Chapter 1 balcony and Ascent count once — 8 x 2 + 1 + 1 = 18.
Disputed: whether the Chapter 1 balcony counts. PowerPyx calls it pending confirmation, OutputLag says it counts and vanishes after the chapter, eGamers reports the walkthrough author unsure.
Safe play: meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1 and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
100% needs only 15 of 18 meditations, but the trophy appears to need all 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason-only, starting after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break with a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. A clean one-shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more — but the exact animal that triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; the chain starts after the Chapter 2 'Coffee Break', is Jason-only (Lucia gets no message), and a text marks 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' in Lummox County.
Pick up the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' from the Ammu-Nation weapons locker.
A clean one-shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but it is not required for the trophy.
All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%; the exact animal that triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed. Hidden until earned.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. The long grind of the list: 100% needs 15 of 18 sets, and skipping the biggest set still needs at least 372 cards. Sell duplicates freely — sold cards stay counted.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets; 100% needs 15 of 18 sets.
If you skip the biggest set, 15 of 18 still needs at least 372 cards.
Cards sold to a pawn shop stay counted in Collections.
Card sets feed the 100% checklist, so they double-count toward A Long Road.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. Scan with Up then R1, and the 100% checklist needs the same 100 — the trophy and the checklist line finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.
Scan by holding Up, then R1.
Track them in Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
100% also needs 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist line finish together.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Eighty exist, so there is slack — but 100% needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 and the checklist line follows.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Complete 50 challenges; 80 exist, so ten more than the trophy needs.
Track them in Progress > Challenges; a 'Completed' mark appears at bottom right when you scroll over a challenge.
100% needs 70 of 80 challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Earliest after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break: call your partner, grab a fast sports bike, and leave the red heat zone — the flashing search area does not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape; earliest after the Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'.
Call your partner by holding Right + Triangle, then escape on a fast sports bike; the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia is a good route.
The trophy pops once you leave the red 'heat' zone — not the flashing search area.
It also pops automatically during the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the stars flashing red/blue — never full red heat — and work the three jewelry shops north of Vice City after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level; only after the Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'.
Keep the wanted level flashing red/blue — not full red heat — and bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline.
Three jewelry shops north of Vice City work well after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'; rob several items per shop, ideally the backroom safe with sticky bombs.
The pop can lag about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if the chain breaks because the stars vanish (only red heat left), it fails.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning is enough — you never need to drive them. Work busy roads with WAiNK and check the counter in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles; 557 exist at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Scan with WAiNK — hold Up for instant use, R1 to scan; scan cars passing on busy roads.
Check progress in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; scanning alone counts, driving is not needed.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. You have only seconds, so refill the focus bar first, extend it with Adrenaline, and pick a rifle with punch — the Duke 556. Police, soldiers and civilians do not count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming); it drains the purple focus bar at top left and lasts only seconds.
Refill focus by eating, drinking, or washing your face or showering at home; Adrenaline extends it (hold L1, then Triangle).
The Duke 556 assault rifle is a good pick; police, soldiers and civilians do not count.
Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise it at the shooting range, golf, pool, fishing, and headshots — each fish caught adds about 10% to the meter.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: take a large plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked on the field do not count — reverse it to the runway and fly 1 km. Some lists call this a second missable, so save first.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: use a large plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked on the field do not count.
Climb aboard, reach the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway and take off; gates E3/E4 are the easiest, or walk in through the terminal.
Break through the field fence; stairs beside the boarding bridge lead straight to the plane door.
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) to pop it. Watch: some top-10 lists call this a second missable — save first.

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island south-west of the map, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Enter through the gate or by stunt jump at the south-east entrance.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Find the tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island south-west of the map in Mariana County; the tank sits south of the base.
Enter through the gate or by stunt jump at the south-east entrance.
Climb in, shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, use the Snap Gun — it stays in your inventory and never needs equipping — instead of kicking the door, then clear the backroom and leave quietly.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store undetected; available after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' at Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City.
The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping; kicking the door trips the alarm, the Snap Gun keeps it stealthy.
Note the safe code in the backroom, destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm there.
The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vaults open in the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — follow the security van, bring your partner (you cannot carry it all alone), and expect an instant 4-star wanted level. Grade note: this is Silver, not Bronze as Push Square lists it.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; the vaults open in the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)'.
Follow the security van until it stops at the bank; a guard carries a briefcase and the vault opens. You cannot carry all the money alone — bring your partner and hold Right to hand over one bag.
After the quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for van tips (first rob 2 Payday Loans); robbing a vault means an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap vehicles.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total, worth up to $205,000 per bank.
Grade note: Push Square lists this as Bronze, but the kit, Exophase, GTABase and OutputLag agree it is Silver (40G) — this guide uses Silver.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 vault mission as Maximum Withdrawal — robbing a vault counts as robbing an armored truck — or ambush a truck near a bank with a sticky bomb on its rear door.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Rob an armored truck and escape; it unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 vault mission, since robbing a vault counts as robbing an armored truck.
Escape the red heat zone or drive to a Pay 'n' Spray.
Earlier method: ambush an armored truck near a bank and stick a sticky bomb on the rear door; sticky bombs sit behind Yasmani's shop after his quest.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — five counties, from the Leonida Keys to Mount Kalaga National Park. Travel with WAiNK out: scanning while you explore feeds two other trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Explore every area of Leonida; the state has five counties — Mariana, Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly and Lummox — including the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
WAiNK scanning while you travel doubles as progress toward You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good.
Area discovery feeds the 100% Discovery group (vehicles 200/277, weapons 50/66, animals 100/255).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Gang operations total 39 and the 100% checklist needs all 39 — no slack — so plan them before the finale.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each gang; gang operations total 39 and all 39 are needed for 100%.
100% needs gang operations 39 of 39 — no slack, so plan them before the finale.
Illegal operations are the gang side of the robbery system alongside bank jobs, payday loans, smash 'n' grabs and stick ups.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx reports the method — Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini, drunk standing beside the bar — but GTABase still lists the steps as unconfirmed, so this one carries an amber trust mark and both versions are shown.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — PowerPyx's reported method: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing beside the bar.
GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so treat the method as reported, awaiting a second confirmation.
Hidden until earned.
Trust: amber — shown with both versions in Sources disagree.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx reports the method — steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and drive it through the window — but GTABase still lists the steps as unconfirmed. Only that blue Banshee counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — PowerPyx's reported method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and drive it through the showroom window.
You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'; only that blue Banshee counts. The pop can lag until after you are driving on the road; the scene nods to GTA III.
GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed — both versions are shown in Sources disagree.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. Three items wait inside, but you do not need all three in one visit, and the robbery icon respawns, so it is not missable. Corrected flag: this trophy is HIDDEN.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (a gang operation).
Three items are inside: a luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (north-east corner table) and a safe in the north-east corridor (sticky bomb).
The trophy pops after you escape the police; it is not missable — the robbery icon respawns and you can return for leftover items, and you do not need all three in one visit.
Hidden until earned — corrected from earlier lists that showed it visible.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Buy a gym membership and train together with your partner — they join the workout. Pair it with the Master of None activity tour.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Buy a gym membership and train together with your partner; your partner joins the workout.
Pair the gym sessions with the Master of None activity tour — the 9 activity types are tracked in Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
The trophy is hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players earn it without trying — just turn on the profile notifications and play normally, and stay away from the permanent Irredeemable tier. Corrected flag: this trophy is HIDDEN.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Make choices, for better or worse — GTABase counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
Most players earn it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch it build.
PowerPyx agrees on 500 actions: check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and watch for the demon-face icon at the right of the screen after each action.
Profile tiers run Professional / Hardened / Violent / Psycho / Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid it.

What exactly counts as one 'action' is not explained by any source — the count is single-source and the definition is unknown. Hidden until earned — corrected from earlier lists that showed it visible.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — and that is all anyone knows. The trigger is not known: PowerPyx guesses a link to the Payday Loans store in the Prologue, and no source has confirmed it. Do not chase it; let it come during normal play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: Second time's the charm — the trigger is not known.
PowerPyx guesses a link to the Payday Loans store in the Prologue; no source has confirmed it.
Status: unconfirmed. Do not chase it — it will most likely pop during normal play.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx reports the method — a UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel after 02:00 — but GTABase still lists the steps as unconfirmed, so this one carries an amber trust mark and both versions are shown.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx's reported method is the UFO easter egg: the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 02:00, arriving alone.
The spawn is somewhat random; a car blinks at the roadside — follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light).
Approach the UFO; it lowers an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer help, and she asks to be taken back to her car at the roadside — do it to pop the trophy.
GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed — both versions are shown in Sources disagree. Hidden until earned.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — and that is all anyone knows. The trigger is not known: PowerPyx guesses knocking someone down while riding a motorbike, GTABase guesses a melee drive-by from a vehicle. Try melee attacks from a moving vehicle during normal play.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the trigger is not known.
PowerPyx guesses knocking someone down while riding a motorbike; GTABase guesses knocking someone down with a melee drive-by from a vehicle.
Status: unconfirmed. Try melee attacks from a moving vehicle during normal play and let it come.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check in Chapter 3, rob banks and Payday Loans, and fence with Yasmani in Vice City — he pays the highest rate. One good vault can hold $205,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts — cumulative across the game.
First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans.
Carry marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the highest rate.
One bank vault can hold up to $205,000, so a single good vault robbery nearly covers the whole $250,000.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, car mods and tattoos burn through money fastest — and every dollar also feeds the other money trophies' economy.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Weapons, car mods and tattoos burn through money fastest.
Leonida's shops: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair & beauty, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story garages, $160,000 in total. They open after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone handles the buying.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story garages, $160,000 in total.
Available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)'; the Vice City Real Estate app notifies you on the phone.
Buy through the app.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, Respray, then Register. Buy a garage first — each one adds parking slots.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; the app installs after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'.
Registered stolen vehicles can be delivered to your location — but buy a garage first, since each garage adds one or more parking slots.
Take a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click 'Respray' then 'Register'; at first Moses only accepts vehicles without a tracker.
From Chapter 3, tracked cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray; registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
